# Catalog

* [Leotard brands, prices and lead times (from the styles research)](brands-and-prices-from-styles-notes.md) - Brand profiles (GK Elite, Sylvia P, Quatro, Snowflake, Plum, Destira, Milano Pro Sport, Christian Moreau), price tiers from budget team basics to Olympic pieces, and lead times, minimums and discounts, as read on 2026-10-13.
* [Leotard price bands](price-bands.md) - List prices seen on 2026-10-13, from about US$20 budget team basics to US$1,000-5,000 Olympic pieces, and the three countable drivers of price: sleeve length, crystal coverage and bespoke versus recoloured.

# Domain Concept

* [Brand self-serve design studios](brand-design-studios.md) - GK UDesign, Sylvia P StudioSP and Quatro's kit builder are template-plus-zones configurators: recolour fixed zones, pick a crystal tier, hand off to a rep. None draws panels or places single stones. Described from vendor text only.
* [Leotard brand landscape](brand-landscape.md) - Who makes competition leotards in 2026: GK Elite leads, Sylvia P and Quatro are the international custom houses, Snowflake, Plum and Destira serve US clubs cheaper, and Milano Pro Sport is in liquidation.
* [Demand evidence for self-serve design](demand-evidence.md) - Evidence that buyers want to design leotards themselves is indirect: brands have paid to build studios and Dressmaker shows appetite for garment-making, but no coach, club or parent statement asking for a 3D tool was found.
* [Professional 3D fashion CAD](professional-fashion-cad.md) - CLO, Marvelous Designer, Browzwear VStitcher, Style3D and Optitex share one pattern-first, cloth-simulation model with weeks of learning and no purpose-built rhinestone tooling; useful as an export target, not as a competitor for fast decorative design.
* [Rhinestone and embellishment layout software](rhinestone-layout-software.md) - Hotfix template software (Stitch Era / Hotfix Era, TRW Design Wizard) already offers area fills, manual single-stone placement, overlap solving and per-size template output; flat, 2D and cutter-oriented, with no 3D garment preview found.
* [Teamwear configurators and configurator platforms](teamwear-configurators.md) - owayo, Spized and white-label platforms (Kit Builder, Zakeke, Expivi, Threekit) follow one pattern for sublimated jerseys: template, zone colours, logos and names, 3D preview, human check, print-ready file. None handles leotards or physical embellishment.
* [The unoccupied gap (provisional)](unoccupied-gap.md) - Between brand configurators (recolour fixed templates) and fashion CAD (pattern-first, weeks to learn) no leotard tool was found that lets a user draw panels or place stones in real time; a provisional finding from one cut-short search pass.

# Process

* [Custom leotard ordering process](custom-order-process.md) - How clubs buy custom leotards today: enquiry, designer or rep, emailed concepts, revisions, sign-off, sizing kits, then 4-13 weeks of production, usually team-only, with minimums and non-returnable goods.
